sloka: शक्यम् दिवम् च आर्जयितुम् वसुधाम् च अपि शासितुम् ।त्वतः अहम् वधम् आकांक्षयन् वार्यमाणो अपि तारया ॥४-१८-५७॥
transliteration: śakyam divam ca ārjayitum vasudhām ca api śāsitum ।tvataḥ aham vadham ākāṁkṣayan vāryamāṇo api tārayā ॥4-18-57॥

translations.english: 'It is possible for a person favoured by you to rule the kingdom.It is possible for one who is under your control and acts according to your will to rule the entire world and earn heaven.
